choice_data_list: I wish I could've caught more, though...

I was watching, you know?
You were going 'hrmmm~' staring down the crane arm—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Watching you work so hard just for me!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "So I wanna take good care of this little guy! It's super special because you worked so hard to win it for me, Trainy♪"
